notes.title: Early Access Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
My Card Is Better Than Your Card! will be coming to Steam Early Access on October 6th, 2025! 🐸⭐
[previewyoutube="3L02RMI8Pmc;full"][/previewyoutube]
Just two more weeks to our Early Access release! Please check out our new trailer above. A huge thanks to everyone who have supported us by playing our demo, providing us with feedback and participating in our playtests!⭐

notes.title: Early Access launches in October 2025!
notes.content:
Big announcement! My Card Is Better Than Your Card! is coming to Steam Early Access in 

October 2025!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598452/f4d5d84e1a31b193c91e5bf0b4450ec2646b5c3a.png"]
Why Early Access? 
Originally, we planned to launch the game as full release by October with a more limited set of features. But, thanks to the support our game has received, we realized that it would now be possible for us to aim for a more feature-rich full release version of our game than we had previously thought. Instead of delaying the release, we feel Early Access is the better option. 

The support and love we’ve received for this game has been amazing, and words aren’t enough to express how blown away and grateful we are for that! Through your feedback we’ve heard lots of great wishes and suggestions that we agree with and want to see in the full version of the game. We want to be able to make more of those ideas come true. Going into Early Access will help us make the game better with you, our community.  

The game will be fully playable at Early Access launch with a bunch of new content! 


Features at Early Access launch include: 
Over 200 adorable and cool stickers to discover! (Over three times more than in the demo!)  

Over 40 toys to play with! (And now you can get more during your runs!) 

Ten unique opponents to play against – 5 new friends since the demo! And you could even run into different versions of them, with different decks and playstyles 

3 challenging bosses to truly test your deckbuilding skills at the end of each week 

10 starter decks with their own themes and playstyles to unlock and choose from for each run 

Super special Story Events to spend time with your friends from the neighborhood! Challenge them to water fights or go on an adventure in the forest! Who knows what’ll happen! 

15 different types of themed Booster Packs to open 

Our very own original soundtrack 

Three special Sticker types that change how the stickers play! (Two new types in addition to Holographic!)



What else has changed since the demo release? 
Since our Next Fest demo, we’ve added quite a lot of content and new features! A huge thank you to our players for all the feedback! Besides the list of features above, here are more new additions we’ve made to the game since our demo!    

Better crafting experience 

Smarter opponents: we taught the children how to play the game better, so get ready for a   challenge

Sudden showdown: a new game mechanic to prevent card battles from dragging on for too long  

Achievements 

Got rid of a lot of bugs (not the cute ones), and improved the technical side of things

Huge balancing improvements 

More super cool visuals and sound effects 

New quality of life settings 



How long will Early Access last?
We estimate that the game will be in Early Access for approximately 9 to 12 months. We have made sure to include time to add features based on our players’ suggestions. 


What’s going to be added to the game during Early Access? 
Through Early Access we will add new content and features at a steady pace. We will keep you informed on how we’re advancing with regular development updates! 

Here’s an outline of what we’ve planned to add to the game before 1.0 release. Please note that these features are not in specific order and the plans may change if needed.  

Character customization!! 

Challenge modes! Test out how you can fare in the game with very different demanding or maybe even silly rules 

Expanded Collections! View to see what you’ve accomplished in the game and stare longingly at your favorite cards 

Different difficulty settings for runs 

Even more stickers, toys, opponents and bosses! 

More controls for sticking stickers exactly the way you want on the cards 

More visual customization  

Steam Deck support 

Controller support 

Accessibility settings 

Quality of life improvements 




What’s going to happen to the demo? 
Right now, we’re focusing on getting ready for the Early Access launch. We may disable the demo closer to Early Access launch, since the demo is a bit outdated at this point. Players trying out the demo might not get an accurate picture of what the Early Access version of the game is like, because of all the new content, features and improvements we’ve added to the game. The demo will come back as an updated version later! 


Feel free to ask if you have any questions! 
We apologize for the late announcement, and we wish we could’ve done it sooner. Every one of us here at Utu Studios is excited about what this all will mean for My Card Is Better Than Your Card! and we can’t wait for everyone to get their hands on all the new things we’ve added to the game. We’ll try our best to answer any questions you might have about the Early Access release. Thank you for reading through this!

notes.title: 20 000 wishlists! Secret Sauce showcase! Upcoming playtests!
notes.content:
We reached 20000 wishlists 🐸🎺 incredible! Thank you thank you for all the support 💖💖 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598452/964b717449574f311996cd065b66115e89304e6c.png"]
Secret Sauce
On this Saturday July 19th, we will be taking part in Secret Sauce Showcase, hosted by Offbrand Games, tune in for a special announcement from us and for all the awesome indie games being showcased! The showcase will be aired on the associated Secret Sauce Steam Sale page, and also on at least the following channels: 


Offbrand Games
Ludwig
IGN 
Gamespot 


Upcoming playtests
Our next playtest is planned for July 25th - July 28th! Join our Discord to sign up for it and future playtests ⭐ 
We plan to hold several playtests as we develop the full release version of the game to test and gather feedback on game balance and new features 😉

notes.title: Demo update Jun 14
notes.content:
We made the following changes to the demo! All stickers should be able to be added to Collections. Please note that for a sticker to be added into your Collection, the sticker needs to be in your deck, on a card, at the run's end. Happy collecting! 🐸

Stickers


 Changed Bug sticker drop chances so they can be added to Collections 
 Changed holo Star drop chance so it can be added to Collections

notes.title: 10000 wishlists! And There's Plenty Of Next Fest Left!
notes.content:
We reached a cool milestone yesterday! WE PASSED 10000 WISHLISTS! ⭐ 
The support we've seen for the game has really blown us all away! All of our goals we had going into Next Fest have been already surpassed, and there's still a few days left!  

Huge thanks to everyone for playing the demo and for being so wonderful! We will work hard to make the full game even better, if you want to help us on that journey, consider joining our Discord! Feedback on the demo and any bug reports are always very very helpful!

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts! 🥰


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598452/bbf2ffaedfa6ff97d99444ff28d85d1da67da67d.png"]

Events

Stickers

Misc
Bug fixes

notes.title: My Card Is Better Than Your Card - at Next Fest!
notes.content:
It's finally here! Next Fest
We've really worked hard on the demo to bring the best possible experience for you to try during Next Fest.

Huge thanks to everyone who has helped us with feedback and bug reports, from our friends and family who playtested before we launched the demo, to our wonderful, awesome community that continues to bring smiles to our faces each day since we made the demo public 🥰

Try out the demo and let us know what you think! Best place to share your thoughts would be here on Steam or on our Discord. If you want to support us, let your friends know about the demo and consider adding the game to your wishlist.

Thank you for support!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598452/aee032bc452ff9b647f59e994b5dffaa5dcfbcf6.png"]

notes.title: Demo Update Notes Jun 9
notes.content:

Misc

 Localization fixes
 Bug fixes

Opponents

Misc

notes.title: Demo Update Notes Jun 2
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for playing the demo, we made some changes based on player feedback! Let us know what you think about the changes in our Discord or here in the community forums. 

Events

 You will now get one event more each day

Treasure Hunt

 Can't give coins anymore but you earn more from card battles

Recycling Center

 You can now recycle up to 3 cards during this event
 You no longer get to keep the stickers from recycled cards

Stickers

 General drop rate adjustments

Fishing Rod

 Now rolls separately for each fish

Octopus

 Look 3 (down from 4) to draw 1 (down from 2)

Starter Packs

 2 new Starter Packs
 Bug deck now uses the Bug Container item
 First new starter pack is unlocked faster than before

Opponents

 All new opponent decks
 Opponent decks evolve day by day
 The choices are more varied who to card battle
 They are smarter

Misc

 Bug fixes
